description: A \u escape of a lone low surrogate becomes U+FFFD
notes: RFC 7159, which the spec adopts as its grammar, allows a \u escape of a lone surrogate but says the behavior of software receiving it is unpredictable, and an HCL string is a sequence of Unicode characters, which a lone surrogate isn't. hashicorp/hcl decodes strings with Go's encoding/json (parseString in json/parser.go), which replaces a lone surrogate with U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER.
